summary: Gemini Space Station, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 14, 2026, reporting the filing of a prospectus supplement to its Form S-3 registration statement. The supplement registers the potential resale of up to 7,142,857 shares of Class A common stock by Winklevoss Capital Fund, LLC, the selling securityholder, issued under a May 14, 2026 securities purchase agreement. The registration does not obligate the investor to sell, and no offering terms, price, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing is a routine resale registration shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for potential selling pressure from the registered overhang.
